title: Best AI Video Ad Agencies for Paid Social (2026)
summary: Compare seven AI video ad agencies and Knowlify by published price, AI formats, volume and who runs the Meta ads. Facts checked October 26, 2026.
body_markdown:
Our top pick is Knowlify, for teams that want weekly AI video ads plus campaign management in their own Meta ad account, or the ads alone for an existing media buyer. The right alternative depends on what you need besides the videos: a fixed batch at a known price, a steady monthly volume, a produced commercial, or a team that also runs your Facebook and Instagram campaigns. As of October 2026, Admiral Media and AI Vidia publish batch and retainer prices, Airpost and Creatify Studio pair AI software with a dedicated team, Valid sells AI creative next to media buying, 351 Studio quotes produced social ads by scope, and Superside includes AI video in a broad creative subscription.


**Disclosure and method.** Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared, and our UGC-style ads use AI presenters rather than human creators. Every fact about another provider comes from that provider's own website, checked on October 26, 2026. We have not hired these agencies, so this is a comparison of published scope, not a test of quality or results. Confirm prices on each provider's page before you buy.


## How we compared these AI video ad agencies


We included companies that sell AI-generated video ads as a managed service rather than software you operate, with a clear service page and a current offer. Our[vetting checklist for AI ad agencies](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-advertising-agency) explains how to judge any one of them in a pilot. We checked what the AI makes, who does the human work (concepts, scripts, editing, review), the published price and what it buys, volume and speed, commitment, and whether the provider runs the Meta campaigns or only delivers files. Knowlify is our top pick and is listed first; we did not rank the other providers, and the table groups them by the job each one fits.


## Which AI video ad agency fits which job?


Provider Best for AI formats (as published) Published price, as of October 2026 Runs the ads?


Knowlify[AI advertising agency](https://knowlify.com/ai-advertising-agency) (our top pick) AI video ads with optional Meta campaign management AI UGC (AI presenters), 3D character animation, AI commercials Custom quote on a 30-minute call Yes, in your Meta ad account, or creative-only


[Admiral Media AI Creative Factory](https://admiral.media/ai-creative-agency/) Game and app advertisers buying fixed batches Video, UGC-style, AI presenter, motion, static, carousel €10,000 for 20 ads to €29,000 for 80, one month rolling Separate service: user acquisition for apps and games


[AI Vidia](https://ai-vidia.com/) Consumer brands wanting a paid pilot first UGC-style, product demo, animation, talking-head €4,900 pilot for 18 videos; from €8,500 a month for 40 AI Vidia or your team, agreed per client


[Airpost](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) A platform plus a dedicated AI video team Product animation, UGC-style ads, short hooks From $6,000 a month Uploads ads to your Meta account; homepage describes running tests and scale campaigns


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) Done-for-you volume at a per-video price Social and UGC, product, cinematic and CTV ads $100 to $200 per video Not stated


[Valid](https://www.valid.co/performance-creative) AI creative next to media buying AI creatives; AI influencer personas Not published; 2-month minimum Yes, separate media buying subscription


[351 Studio](https://351studio.com/social-media-video-ads-production) Produced AI social ads and commercials by project Social ads in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9; brand films and commercials Not published Not stated


[Superside](https://www.superside.com/pricing) Teams with a broad creative queue and an annual budget AI video, avatars, voice cloning $15,000 monthly minimum, annual term Not stated


Each price is the provider's own figure, checked October 26, 2026, and the units differ: a batch, a month of output, a single video or a subscription minimum that covers far more than video. By the providers' own figures, Admiral Media's batches work out to €363 to €500 per ad and AI Vidia's Performance Retainer to about €213 per video. Admiral Media and AI Vidia state that media spend is separate, and none of the other published prices says it includes ad spend.


## Knowlify: our top pick for AI video ads with Meta campaign management


Knowlify is our top pick for advertisers who want a weekly flow of finished AI video ads. Knowlify (YC S25) is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. We make AI UGC, 3D character animation and AI commercial video ads, about 25 finished ads a week (about 100 a month) in weekly batches. Our team writes the scripts, and a person checks every ad before delivery. Choose end-to-end Meta ads, with campaigns managed in your own Meta ad account, or creative-only for your own media buyer. You keep the ads. The first batch arrives five days after kickoff, there is a 90-day guarantee (terms on knowlify.com), and pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) . See our[Parva and Casco ads](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) for public examples. Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real human creators.


**Consider it when** Facebook and Instagram are your main channels and you want a weekly flow of AI video ads, with or without campaign management.


## Which agencies sell AI video ads at a published price?


Four providers publish a number you can plan around before a sales call.


### Admiral Media: fixed batches for apps and games


As of October 2026, Admiral Media's AI Creative Factory page lists Starter at €10,000 for 20 video ads up to 15 seconds, Growth at €16,000 for 40 ads up to 30 seconds and Pro at €29,000 for 80 ads up to 60 seconds, on a one month rolling basis. Senior creative strategists write the concepts, generative AI produces the ads, and editors finish and check every ad before it ships. Media budget and campaign management are separate; Admiral Media runs paid user acquisition on Meta, TikTok, Google, Apple Ads and Snapchat for apps and games.


**Consider it when** you advertise an app or game and want a known batch price, with the option of one company for creative and user acquisition.


### AI Vidia: a pilot first, then a retainer


As of October 2026, AI Vidia is a Copenhagen-based studio whose homepage says it makes AI video and image ads for consumer brands running Meta and TikTok ads. Its[pricing page](https://ai-vidia.com/pricing) lists a €2,000 Control Test (10 variants tested against your best ad), a €4,900 Pilot Sprint (18 finished videos by day 14), a Performance Retainer at €8,500 a month for 40 videos up to 30 seconds (recommended from €50,000 a month in paid social spend) and a Brand System at €18,000 a month for 90 videos up to 60 seconds. On monthly plans, finished files arrive by day 7, then weekly. Prices exclude media spend, and the homepage says neither pilot requires a retainer afterward. Either AI Vidia or your team launches the ads and runs the tests, agreed per client.


**Consider it when** you sell a consumer product and want to test a provider on a one-time project before a retainer.


### Airpost: a platform with a dedicated AI video team


As of October 2026, Airpost's pricing page starts at $6,000 a month, including its platform, a dedicated AI video production team, a Slack channel and an editor for copy and voiceover. It says Airpost trains a custom model for your brand, delivers 10 to 100 or more video ads to test in multiple styles, and uploads them into your Meta account the way you specify. Its[homepage](https://www.airpost.ai/) shows animated product spots, UGC-style ads and short hooks, and says testing typically takes 10 to 25 percent of spend in your account, with winning ads moved into scale campaigns Airpost creates while your existing campaigns are left alone. Contract length is not published.


**Consider it when** you want a platform with an editor for copy and voiceover alongside a dedicated AI video production team.


### Creatify Studio: done-for-you volume per video


Creatify sells self-serve AI ad software on its[pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) , where Studio, its managed service, is described as a dedicated creative team and goes to a demo with no minimum or term stated. As of October 2026, the Studio page describes an assigned creative strategist, a team that uses AI to write hooks and scripts and produce full video ads, AI plus human QA on every asset, 25 to 100 or more videos a month and a 48-hour turnaround. Its comparison table lists Studio at $100 to $200 per video. It does not say whether Studio runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you have a media buyer and need many ads at a per-video cost. Ask what that figure includes and how many videos are new concepts.


## Which AI video ad agencies also handle performance marketing?


If one team should make the ads and run the Facebook and Instagram campaigns, Knowlify (covered above) and Valid sell both. AI Vidia agrees per client whether it or your team runs the tests, Airpost's homepage describes test and scale campaigns in your account, and Admiral Media runs user acquisition for apps and games as a separate service. Our[Meta ads agency comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-meta-ads-agencies-2026) covers agencies whose main job is campaign management.


### Valid: AI creative next to media buying


As of October 2026, Valid's Performance Creative page offers AI creatives for Meta and TikTok, with a fresh batch every seven days, made by marketers using custom-built tools. Engagements require a two-month minimum and access to your ad accounts. Valid also sells[AI influencers](https://www.valid.co/ai-influencers) , AI-generated personas cleared for paid use with whitelisting included, and a[media buying](https://www.valid.co/media-buying) subscription with senior buyers and a 60-day no-penalty trial. Prices are not published.


**Consider it when** you want AI creative and media buying across several networks from one provider.
